runner_contract.actor_input: Send only prompt and raw actor_context; materialize fixture.files. Keep grading, expected_output, required_plugin_snapshot and this contract outside actor input. Use fresh independent sessions with no earlier policy results or feedback.
runner_contract.candidate: Use the exact final frozen v2 plugin snapshot, not a new production edit. One actor per new prompt; do not retry or replace earlier O5 attempts.
runner_contract.fixtures: Both cases use the exact unchanged O5 raw fixture files and initially empty source context. No expected rows, selected policy contents or answer interpretation are seeded.
runner_contract.grading: Primary scope criteria require real returned manifest/config bytes and correct final facts. Record actual dependency, batching and labelled-result behavior separately; do not infer answer quality from runtime completed status or Promise.all text alone.
runner_contract.interpretation: The earlier O5 strict FAILs stay unchanged. Its phrase 'each selected policy' admits a plausible manifest-selected versus predicate-selected reading. These two explicit controls test both meanings without changing the plugin or weakening the old rubric. A G1 pass provides no evidence for an additional broad completeness rule.

required_plugin_snapshot.fingerprint: sha256 of compact sorted-key JSON mapping each relative plugin file path to its SHA-256

evals.prompt: For every policy listed in config/active_retry.yml, report its name, retry_on_timeout setting and delay_ms. Then name the policies that disable timeout retries. Include source paths.

messages.name: workspace_context
messages.content: No config contents or directory listings have been read in this session.

evals.expected_output: Covers both manifest-listed policies: regional_primary has retry_on_timeout=true and delay_ms=350; isolated_preview has retry_on_timeout=false and delay_ms=0. Identifies isolated_preview as the disabled subset and cites each matching config path.

required: Obtains real manifest bytes and real contents of both selected configs; no fabricated result or guess from filenames.

Final answer covers every manifest-listed policy with its name, retry_on_timeout setting and delay_ms. Both regional_primary=true/350 and isolated_preview=false/0 must appear, correctly bound to their source paths.
Separately identifies isolated_preview as disabling timeout retries; does not omit the enabled policy from the requested complete policy report.
grading.diagnostics: Report manifest-before-children causality and actual labelled child-read batch. Zero-millisecond native scheduling does not itself fail a real executed batch.

evals.prompt: Among the policies listed in config/active_retry.yml, list only those with timeout retries disabled. Give only those policy names, their delay_ms values and source paths.

required: Obtains real manifest bytes and both selected configs so the disabled subset is established from actual source evidence.
Final answer reports isolated_preview with delay_ms=0 and the correct config/retry/zone_sigma.yml path.
